findings.description: R1 (build passes from clean state, produces dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs) has no automated test that could fail if the build were broken. Add a test that removes dist, runs the build, asserts exit 0 and that both outputs exist, naming R1.
findings.evidence: Developer report lists 4 tests, all theme tests (ResponsiveTable.theme.test.tsx, useResolvedTheme.test.ts) merely relabelled with 'R1'. No source/config/test file changed (empty diff). None runs rollup or checks dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs, so none would fail if `npm run build` broke (e.g. a CSS import or rollup config error, which jest does not exercise). The acceptance lines 'npm run build exits 0 from clean state' and 'dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs exist' and the edge case 'must pass from a clean state (dist deleted)' have no test. The twice-in-a-row reliability check was run by hand only.
findings.note: src/Build.test.ts was added (only changed file). Test 1 removes dist, runs `npm run build` via execSync (which throws on a non-zero exit) and asserts dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs exist; test 2 repeats the build and asserts the same, covering the twice-in-a-row reliability check. Both name R1. I ran `npx jest src/Build.test.ts --verbose`: 2 passed, 2 total, ~27s. This fails if rollup errors or if either output is not produced, so it would notice the build breaking.

findings.description: Record the Node and npm versions used for the clean-state runs, and state plainly that the original failure was not reproduced, so the build is not claimed fixed on inference.
findings.evidence: Edge case: 'If a build error can only be reproduced under other conditions, the error message and cause must be recorded'. The report says the npm log is missing and the cause is 'most likely' earlier in-progress theme work. This is a guess, with no recorded Node version, no npm log and no error message.

findings.description: The packed-library install and import check (CommonJS and ES modules) did not run. A manual `npm pack` and import of dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs would give some evidence that the build output is usable.
findings.evidence: The project has no scripts/consumer-smoke.mjs. The build report does not mention packing the library or importing it under CommonJS and ES modules. The analyst put scaffolding out of scope.

findings.description: The 'type-check exits 0' and 'theme CSS/TS introduce no build errors' acceptance lines rest on a manual run only.
findings.evidence: The report says the tests 'compile under type-check', but jest compilation is not `tsc --noEmit`. No test or script step ties `npm run type-check` exit 0 to anything.

findings.description: Add or explicitly note an automated type-check step (or record that it stays manual) so the 'type-check exits 0' acceptance line has proof of its own.
findings.evidence: The clean-state edge case is now covered: Build.test.ts deletes dist, runs rollup via `npm run build`, and asserts dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs exist (would throw/fail if the build broke). The acceptance line 'npm run type-check exits with code 0' still has no automated test of its own; it was only run by hand. Rollup's typescript plugin compiles the theme .ts/.tsx, so most type errors would also fail the build test, but the dedicated `tsc --noEmit` script is not exercised by any test.

findings.description: Record the Node and npm versions used for the clean-state runs and state plainly that the original failure was not reproduced on the current tree.
findings.evidence: Edge case: 'If a build error can only be reproduced under conditions other than the current tree ... the error message and cause must be recorded'. The report states only that no production/config file changed; it records no Node/npm version and no error message, and the referenced npm log is missing. The failure is treated as fixed without a recorded original cause.

findings.description: The packed-library install-and-import check did not run, so the build output is proven to exist but not to be consumable.
findings.evidence: No scripts/consumer-smoke.mjs exists and the build report does not pack the library or import dist/index.js / dist/index.mjs under CommonJS and ES modules. The project note marks this check as not set up, and the analyst scoped scaffolding out, so nothing proves the packed output imports. A manual `npm pack` + CJS/ESM import of the two dist entry files would give some evidence.
